title: A Drink at the Cafe
summary: You will learn cafe drinks, sizes, and how people pay. Then you will practise three short talks.

cover.alt: Cafe counter with a tea cup, a coffee cup, coins, and a payment card under warm window light.

blocks.title: At the Cafe
paragraphs: You will learn cafe drinks, sizes, and how people pay. Then you will practise three short talks.

items.prompt: Do you like tea or coffee?
Do you like a small drink or a large drink?
Do you use cash or a card?

blocks.title: Drinks and Size
paragraphs: A cafe order can start with a drink name. Tea and coffee are two drinks people can order. A drink can be hot or cold. The size is another part of the order. A small cup holds less than a large cup. The drink and the size go together in an order. Mara works at a cafe and makes the drinks. One person wants hot tea in a small cup. Mara hears the drink name, but not the size. She asks about the size before she makes it. The person says small, and the order is clear. Mara makes the hot tea in a small cup.

items.prompt: You want hot tea in a small cup. What is your full order?
items.explanation: The order gives the size and the drink together.

blocks.title: Cash or Card
paragraphs: People pay for their drinks when they order at this cafe. Cash is money in coins or notes. A card is another way to pay here. Mara takes both cash and cards at the counter. One person orders a coffee and wants to pay. The person has a card but has no cash. Mara says a card is fine for this order. The person uses the card to pay for the coffee. Mara says the payment is done, so the person stops. A receipt shows what the person bought and paid. The person takes the receipt and the coffee. The drink is paid for, and the order is complete.

items.prompt: You have a card but no cash. What can you ask before you pay?
items.explanation: This asks whether you can use your card.

blocks.title: For Here or To Go
paragraphs: Some people drink their tea at a cafe table. Other people take their drinks away from the cafe. For here means the person will stay at the cafe. To go means the person will take the drink away. Mara asks this before she gives someone a drink. One person orders a small tea to go. Mara puts a large cup on the counter by mistake. The person sees the cup before Mara makes the tea. The order was for a small tea, not a large tea. The person asks for a small cup. Mara takes a small cup and makes the tea. The person takes the small tea away from the cafe.

items.prompt: You ordered a small tea to go. You see a large cup before the tea is made. What can you say?
items.answer: A small cup, please. To go.
items.explanation: This gives the right size and says you will take the tea away.

blocks.title: Say Where and Fix the Size
A Hot Tea
paragraphs: You are at the cafe counter with Mara, the barista. You want a small hot tea and will sit at a table.
Your goal is to order a small hot tea for here.

images.alt: Customer and barista Mara at a cafe counter with a small cup, a large cup, and steaming tea.

turns.speaker: Mara
turns.text: One small hot tea for here.

blocks.title: Coffee and a Card
paragraphs: You are at the counter with Mara, the barista, and want a small coffee to go. This cafe takes cash and cards, and you have a card.
Your goal is to order your coffee and pay by card.

images.alt: Customer pays by card at a cafe counter while barista Mara holds a small coffee and a receipt.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: A small coffee to go, please.

turns.speaker: Mara
turns.text: A small coffee to go. Cash or card?

turns.speaker: Mara
turns.text: Your payment is done. Here is your receipt and your coffee.

blocks.title: The Right Cup
paragraphs: You ordered a small tea to go from Mara, the barista. Mara has put a large cup on the counter but has not made the tea yet.
Your goal is to get your tea in a small cup to go.

images.alt: Customer points to a small empty takeaway cup beside a large empty cup on the cafe counter.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, a small tea to go.

turns.speaker: Mara
turns.text: Here is a small cup. I will make your tea now.

turns.speaker: Mara
turns.text: Here is your small tea to go.

items.prompt: Ordering at the counter: You want a small hot tea to go. Mara is the barista, and the cafe takes cash and cards. Give your full order and say how you want to pay. Then Mara puts out a large cup. Ask for the right size.
items.explanation: Give the drink, size, and place first. Then say cash or card. Ask for a small cup at the end.

items.prompt: A cafe order includes a drink and a size. Cash and cards are ways to pay. What drink would you order, and how would you pay?
items.explanation: What would you say if the cup was the wrong size?

a drink made with tea leaves and water
how big or small something is
a small plastic card used to pay
